title: Flat bones: MedlinePlus Medical Encyclopedia
content: Flat bones Flat bones are made up of a layer of spongy bone between two thin layers of compact bone. They have a flat shape, not rounded. Examples include the skull and rib bones. Flat bones have marrow, but they do not have a bone marrow cavity. Images Skull Ribs and lung anatomy References Fillmore EP. Thoracic wall and breast. In: Standring S, Tubbs RS, Anand N, et al, eds.
